entities.summary: Maksym Borysovych Zhorin is a Ukrainian soldier and politician who is currently serving as the deputy commander of the 3rd Assault Brigade. Zhorin served as the commander of the Azov Brigade between 2016 and 2017 and is a major in the Armed Forces of Ukraine. Politically, he is serving as the chief of the central staff of the National Corps.
